name: OMA Music
author: Wizwam
description: Native YouTube Music player for Omarchy. Search, library, playlists, mini player, live spectrum, and 10-band EQ, with local mpv + yt-dlp. Not a browser tab and not an MPRIS chip.

barWidget.description: Native YouTube Music player with a mini player, live spectrum, and local mpv playback.

schema.label: Stop local playback when idle
schema.description: Minutes. Use 0 to keep the backend running after you pause.

schema.label: Open mini-player from bar
schema.description: When off, clicking the bar icon opens the full player directly.

schema.label: Keyboard shortcut opens
schema.description: Super+Shift+M on this machine toggles the full player. Mini player remains available from the bar icon.

schema.label: Local playback quality
schema.description: Takes effect the next time a stream is resolved.

schema.label: Show title on the bar
schema.description: Bar chip shows the song title, like the cliamp now-playing pill.

schema.label: Show artist on the bar
schema.description: Bar chip shows the artist before the title.

schema.label: Bar title width
schema.description: Maximum width of the scrolling artist and title on the bar.
